<h2 id="_go_git">go-git</h2>
<div class="paragraph">
<p></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Indien jy Git wil integreer by 'n diens wat in Golang geskryf is, is daar ook 'n suiwer Go-biblioteekimplementering - go-git.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Die projek word gehuisves by <a href="https://github.com/go-git/go-git" class="bare" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://github.com/go-git/go-git</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Dit poog om 'n suiwer Go-implementering van Git te bied wat geen inheemse afhanklikhede ('native dependencies') het nie.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>go-git fokus op uitbreidbaarheid en verenigbaarheid en ondersteun die meeste van die binnewerk-API’s ('plumbing APIs'), wat gedokumenteer is by <a href="https://github.com/go-git/go-git/blob/master/COMPATIBILITY.md" class="bare" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://github.com/go-git/go-git/blob/master/COMPATIBILITY.md</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Hier is 'n basiese voorbeeld van die gebruik van Go-API’s:</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="highlight"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go">import "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"

r, err := git.PlainClone("/tmp/foo", false, &amp;git.CloneOptions{
    URL:      "https://github.com/go-git/go-git",
    Progress: os.Stdout,
})</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Sodra jy 'n <code>Repository</code>-instansie het, kan jy toegang tot inligting verkry en wysigings daarop uitvoer:</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="highlight"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go">// retrieves the branch pointed by HEAD
ref, err := r.Head()

// get the commit object, pointed by ref
commit, err := r.CommitObject(ref.Hash())

// retrieves the commit history
history, err := commit.History()

// iterates over the commits and print each
for _, c := range history {
    fmt.Println(c)
}</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h3 id="_gevorderde_funksionaliteit_2">Gevorderde Funksionaliteit</h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>go-git het 'n paar noemenswaardige gevorderde kenmerke, waarvan een 'n inpropbare bergingstelsel ('pluggable storage system') is, soortgelyk aan Libgit2-agterkante ('backends').
Die verstek-implementering is in-geheue berging ('in-memory storage'), wat baie vinnig is.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="highlight"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go">r, err := git.Clone(memory.NewStorage(), nil, &amp;git.CloneOptions{
    URL: "https://github.com/go-git/go-git",
})</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Inpropbare berging bied baie interessante opsies.
Byvoorbeeld, <a href="https://github.com/go-git/go-git/tree/master/_examples/storage" class="bare" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://github.com/go-git/go-git/tree/master/_examples/storage</a> laat jou toe om verwysings, objekte en konfigurasie in 'n Aerospike-databasis te stoor.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Nog 'n kenmerk is 'n buigsame lêerstelsel-abstraksie.
Deur gebruik te maak van <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-git/go-billy/v5?tab=doc#Filesystem" class="bare" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-git/go-billy/v5?tab=doc#Filesystem</a> is dit maklik om al die lêers op 'n ander manier te stoor, bv. deur almal in 'n enkele argief op 'n skyf saam te pak of deur hulle almal in-geheue te hou.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Nog 'n gevorderde gebruiksgeval sluit 'n fyn-instelbare HTTP-kliënt in, soos dié wat gevind word by <a href="https://github.com/go-git/go-git/blob/master/_examples/custom_http/main.go" class="bare" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://github.com/go-git/go-git/blob/master/_examples/custom_http/main.go</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="highlight"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go">customClient := &amp;http.Client{
    Transport: &amp;http.Transport{ // accept any certificate (might be useful for testing)
        TLSClientConfig: &amp;tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true},
    },
    Timeout: 15 * time.Second,  // 15 second timeout
        CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
        return http.ErrUseLastResponse // don't follow redirect
    },
}

// Override http(s) default protocol to use our custom client
client.InstallProtocol("https", githttp.NewClient(customClient))

// Clone repository using the new client if the protocol is https://
r, err := git.Clone(memory.NewStorage(), nil, &amp;git.CloneOptions{URL: url})</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h3 id="_verdere_leesstof_3">Verdere Leesstof</h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>'n Volledige bespreking van go-git se vermoëns val buite die bestek van hierdie boek.
As jy meer inligting oor go-git wil hê, is daar API-dokumentasie by <a href="https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-git/go-git/v5" class="bare" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-git/go-git/v5</a>, en 'n stel gebruiksvoorbeelde by <a href="https://github.com/go-git/go-git/tree/master/_examples" class="bare" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://github.com/go-git/go-git/tree/master/_examples</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
